output_inventory.contact_sheet_reason: No candidate image was retained in the repository because every exact or contextual lead remained rights-blocked, identity-incomplete, or both.

handoff_requirements.parent_must_obtain: Written permission, an explicit public-domain/Creative Commons or otherwise documented mod-reuse grant, and face-level identity evidence for each requested portrait before processing.
handoff_requirements.parent_must_not_do: Do not substitute group members, generic Oireachtas avatars, later people with the same name, book scans, auction listing images, or unlicensed web reproductions.
handoff_requirements.after_clearance: Preserve the licensed source, create a 156x210 RGBA portrait crop, run the repository DDS converter, add source provenance and rights to the canonical manifest, then wire through the parent-owned GFX surface.
